note: Portal user guide; its only mention of transfers is a form field headed 'Transfert des donnees a l'etranger' with a consent field, no rule or procedure for permission stated.

facts.fact: Law 25-11 of 24 July 2025, published in the Journal Officiel that day, adds article 45 bis 13 to Law 18-07, under which the competent authority assesses the adequate level of protection in a foreign State or international organisation before data are transferred there, for transfers for criminal-justice purposes, and allows transfer on insufficient safeguards only in listed cases (vital interests, public security threat, individual criminal cases); the document gives as_of as its publication date and states no separate entry-into-force date.
facts.system: Loi n° 25-11 modifiant et complétant la loi n° 18-07 (art. 45 bis 13)

facts.fact: Article 45 bis 14, added by the same law of 24 July 2025, bars onward transfer of data received from a foreign State or organisation to another State unless the sending State or organisation has first accepted it, with an exception for the State's fundamental interests or a grave and immediate public-security threat.
facts.system: Loi n° 25-11 modifiant et complétant la loi n° 18-07 (art. 45 bis 14)

facts.fact: The Authority adopted Délibération n° 04 on 15 July 2026 extending the law's rules to images published on social platforms, including treating publication on foreign-run platforms as a transfer abroad.

note: carried from dataprotectionlaw; no document opened

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the 2023 personal data law allows transfers to states with adequate protection and with prior ANPDP authorisation, or on stated conditions such as explicit consent, and bars transfers endangering public security.
facts.system: Law Relating to the Protection of Individuals in the Processing of Personal Data

facts.fact: Digital Policy Alert says the ANPDP has not issued the list of adequate jurisdictions or the declarations for obtaining transfer authorisations.

APS reports that the ANPDP praised the Chlef housing office (OPGI) on 25 November 2026 for applying for prior authorisation to transfer personal data abroad for its Facebook page, so a transfer needs the authority's authorisation.

note: Whether any transfer goes without permission is not stated.
